'''Vine Shambler''' is a normal [[Monsters|Enemy]] found in the [[Overgrowth]].

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Vine Shambler}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Swipe
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (6;{{Asc2|9|7}}) damage ×2.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Grasping Vines
|Intent = Attack2, CardDebuff
|Effect = Deals (8;{{Asc2|9|9}}) damage. Applies 1 {{BD2|Tangled}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Tangled
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Chomp
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (16;{{Asc2|9|18}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Follows a fixed repeating cycle:
# {{Int2|Vine Shambler|Swipe}}
# {{Int2|Vine Shambler|Grasping Vines}}
# {{Int2|Vine Shambler|Chomp}}
# Back to {{Int2|Vine Shambler|Swipe}}

== Useful Cards ==

* Damaging non-attack cards like {{C2|Deadly Poison}} or {{C2|Inferno}} are not affected by '''Tangled''' and can be played for their normal price.
